DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Tumor of the Bone (GCT).

The MRI finding of a well-demarcated lesion in the distal femur, combined with your severe night pain and lack of systemic infection signs, strongly suggests a benign but locally aggressive bone tumor. Given your young age and the specific location, this is the most likely diagnosis. We will need to proceed with a biopsy and possibly surgical intervention.
